resources.string: Connect your LEAKCAM to Wi-Fi: plug it into the phone or bring it near.
1. Plug the LEAKCAM into the phone, or bring it near
Sending the new network for %1$s to the LEAKCAM server…
The LEAKCAM server did not take the new network for %1$s. Check the phone\'s network, then try again.
%1$s takes \"%2$s\" at its next check-in (%3$s). A notification comes if it cannot join it.
Remove %1$s from this phone? With no phone left it goes back to setup mode.
Enter the new Wi-Fi for %1$s. It switches at its next check-in (%2$s); you get a notification if that fails.
The LEAKCAM keeps its password hidden (••••••••): type it to save this network again.
Charging (USB power) · %1$d %% when last on battery
Charging (USB power) · battery not measured yet
%1$s was not deleted: the LEAKCAM server did not answer. Try again with internet.
Plug the LEAKCAM into the phone, or bring it near (on battery it can take up to 5 minutes).
No LEAKCAM found yet. Plug it in or bring it near (on battery up to 5 minutes).
No LEAKCAM found yet. Plug it in or bring it near, and turn Location on (needed for Bluetooth on this Android).
Enter your 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi name and password, then tap Pair, check and save.
Your phone now asks to pair with %1$s: tap Pair. No PIN to type.
The LEAKCAM is now joining \"%1$s\" to check it (up to a minute).
Password accepted. Getting an address from the router…
Connected to the router. Checking that the internet can be reached…
Done. %1$s joined \"%2$s\" and stored it. Another one? Plug it in or bring it near.
Saved without checking. %1$s stored \"%2$s\" and tries it at its next check-in.
This phone has no Bluetooth, which the setup needs.
Bluetooth access (Nearby devices) is needed to find the LEAKCAM.
Saved without checking. %1$s stored \"%2$s\" and tries it at its next check-in.
Leak alerts are off: notifications are not allowed.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on, then tap again.
Scanning failed (error %1$d). Turn Bluetooth off and on: the app looks again by itself.
Pick your board in the list first.
The Wi-Fi name must be 1 to 32 characters long.
The Wi-Fi password must be 8 to 63 characters long, or empty for an open network.
The LEAKCAM did not answer. Keep it near and try again.
The LEAKCAM disconnected (status %1$d). Keep it nearby, then try again.
Pairing did not go through. Try again (the phone needs internet for the pairing code).
This phone keeps an old pairing with %1$s: in Bluetooth settings choose Forget on it, then try again.
The LEAKCAM cannot see \"%1$s\". Check the name (case counts), 2.4 GHz and range.
The router refused the password for \"%1$s\" (code %2$d). Check it and try again.
The router did not let the LEAKCAM join (code %1$d). It may allow only known devices.
The router gave the LEAKCAM no address (DHCP). Check the router and try again.
The LEAKCAM is on the network, but internet names do not resolve. Is the router connected to the internet?
The LEAKCAM is on the network, but it cannot reach the internet. Is the router connected to the internet?
This network needs a login page (answer %1$d): the LEAKCAM cannot use it.
The LEAKCAM reaches the internet but not the LEAKCAM service (answer %1$d). Try again later.
The LEAKCAM could not start the check. Try again.
The LEAKCAM could not store the settings. Try again; if it keeps failing, the board needs service.
The LEAKCAM reported an unexpected result (%1$d). Try again.
The connection to %1$s dropped. Reconnecting to see what it did with the network…
Bluetooth was turned off. Turn it back on: the app reconnects to %1$s to see what it did with the network.
The connection to %1$s dropped before it got the network. Nothing changed: try again.
No pairing code for %1$s: the LEAKCAM server is not reachable. Check the phone\'s internet.
The connection to %1$s dropped: the app cannot tell whether the network was stored. Keep it near and send again.
This device is not a LEAKCAM ready for setup. Keep it nearby and scan again.
The LEAKCAM refused the %1$s (error %2$d). Check it and try again.
Could not send the %1$s. Try again.
Enter the Wi-Fi network %1$s should use (2.4 GHz; empty password for an open one), then tap Pair, check and save.
Sending the Wi-Fi settings to %1$s over the USB cable…
%1$s did not accept its setup code from the server. Unplug the cable, plug it in again and retry.
%1$s refused too many wrong setup codes. Unplug the cable and plug it in again, then retry.
%1$s refused the %2$s over the USB cable (%3$s). Try again.
The USB cable to %1$s was unplugged. Plug it in again and retry.
The cable to %1$s was unplugged before it confirmed the network. Plug it in and send again.
A LEAKCAM found water: full screen and alarm sound, also in silent mode
Water on the probe: its water sensor is wet.
The camera inference saw what looks like water.
Marked as not a leak: %1$s watches again from its next check-in (%2$s).
The LEAKCAM server could not be reached. Check the phone\'s internet and try again.
It could not join "%1$s". Open the app to try again.
present at the server over Wi-Fi
%1$s takes the %2$s at its next check-in (%3$s). You get a notification when it is ready to play.
The request did not reach the LEAKCAM server. Check the phone\'s internet and try again.
Change Wi-Fi to \"%1$s\" (sent, its answer comes next)
That file could not be downloaded. Check the phone\'s internet and try again.
Plug this phone into the board\'s USB-C with the cable
Loosen the lock ring, then turn the lens slowly %1$s (looking into the lens)
Getting blurrier: turn the other way, %1$s
Past the sharpest point: turn back %1$s, in small steps
Sharpest. Hold it, tighten the lock ring, then tap Done
Nothing sharp in view: point the camera at something with detail, check the lens is uncovered
Camera %1$d of LEAKCAM on %2$s is out of focus
Leaks may be missed. Tap to tune it.
Its focus is not set yet. Tap to tune it with the cable.
The board did not take this phone\'s PIN: open the app\'s list and set it up again
Camera %1$d does not answer: check its cable
